title: Zesty Roasted Filipino White Asparagus Ginataang Bilo Bilo
description: A kid-friendly Filipino dish featuring roasted white asparagus in a creamy coconut milk broth, served with soft and chewy bilo bilo balls.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the white asparagus in a single layer.
Drizzle the asparagus with vegetable oil and season with salt.
Roast the asparagus in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until tender.
In a large pot, combine the coconut milk, water, sugar, and grated ginger.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium low.
In a small bowl, mix together the glutinous rice flour and a small amount of water to form a dough.
Use the dough to form small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Add the bilo bilo balls to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the roasted asparagus to the pot and cook for 2 minutes, or until heated through.
